# CloudScale AI Changelog

## [2.4.0] - 2026-09-29

Autonomous Agent Clusters, real-time cryptographic webhook replayer, and SOC2 automated compliance audit telemetry.

### Added
- Autonomous Agent Clusters with distributed multi-region failover and self-healing nodes
- Client-side HMAC-SHA256 Webhook Replayer for Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, and Slack
- Instant 1-click BIND DNS zone file exporter and SPF lookup budget meter

### Changed
- 50% reduction in cold boot latency across serverless edge functions
- Revamped high-contrast cybersecurity dark theme with accessible typography

### Fixed
- Fixed race condition in OAuth callback state verification
- Resolved memory leak in streaming SSE log pipeline during socket reconnects

### Breaking Changes
- Deprecated v1 REST endpoints; migrate to v2 GraphQL or WebSocket subscriptions by Dec 2026

### Security
- Patched timing attack vulnerability in signature header validation using constant-time comparison
